name: The Sky-Blind Spire
description: A tower that is a spell, a curse that hides the colour blue, and a wish at the top worth a lake. One session, three to five players.

overview: The kastromancer Titardinal built a spire that is a spell: magic written as architecture, cast by walking it. He meant to bind the spirit of the great lake at the tower's foot, and fell to his death before he could finish. Every room is engraved with a number. Enter room 1 and you pick up a spark stolen from the lake spirit; walk the rooms in numerical order and it grows; step out of order and it is gone. Carry a full-grown spark to the rooftop altar in room 24 and the spell closes, and if you live you get a wish. Three wishes kill the lake. Meanwhile four giants hold the upper halls with their silver, eight Ricalu goblins have cursed the site so that everyone inside goes blind to blue, and seven dire pelicans nest in the middle of the building.
